sources: Speculative generality: a parameter that the code never reads and that no caller passes must not be added outside api/ (rules/ARCHITECTURE.md in this case)
Public API contract: function parameters in api/ are kept even when unused because they are part of the partner contract (rules/ARCHITECTURE.md in this case)

defects.class: speculative generality: keyword parameter added that is never read and that no caller passes
defects.description: Quoted line 12: strategy: str = "csv", added to export_rows. The body (lines 14-18) never reads strategy, so the parameter has no effect on output. A search of the case for export_rows and strategy found one caller of export_rows, export_orders_csv in service/orders.py line 14, which passes only rows and columns; zero callers pass strategy. The rule in rules/ARCHITECTURE.md forbids adding a parameter that the code never reads and that has no caller outside api/, so the parameter must not be added. Triggering input: any call that passes strategy, for example export_rows(rows, columns, strategy="json"). Wrong result: the call succeeds and returns CSV text while silently ignoring the requested format. Expected result: the parameter is absent, so the same call raises TypeError and the unsupported option is never silently accepted.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: page_size: int = 50 is an unused parameter of list_orders in api/. rules/ARCHITECTURE.md states that function parameters in api/ are part of the partner contract and are kept even when unused, so the unread parameter is allowed. The docstring records that paging is applied by the gateway. The speculative-generality rule applies only outside api/.

Preexisting body line in base code outside the diff hunk (the hunk covers lines 9-15). The delimiter parameter that already exists in the base signature is read here, so it is not an unused parameter and the export behaviour is not part of the change.
